local.rationale: The local client runs coding-agent workspaces on the user computer. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution, Self-hosted remote-server source and deployment instructions.

own-server.rationale: Settings document running Vibe Kanban on a user server and opening files over SSH. Disconnect/continuation was not tested. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution, Self-hosted remote-server source and deployment instructions.

worktree.rationale: Local workspaces create a working branch and Git worktree. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution.

parallel-runs.rationale: Local documentation permits independent running sessions/workspaces; this is documented parallelism, not an observed concurrency measurement. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution.

issue-tracking.rationale: The vendor-hosted issue board is retired. Released project pages are export-only; local workspaces and sessions are a separate surviving workflow. Scope: Retired vendor-hosted issues, projects, comments and organisations.

pr-workflow.rationale: Workspace Git panel documents creating GitHub PRs; authentication and a remote are needed. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution.

review-ui.rationale: Workspace changes panel documents code diffs and inline agent feedback. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution.

license.rationale: Pinned repository root is licensed Apache-2.0, subject to component/dependency notices. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution, Tauri desktop client, Self-hosted remote-server source and deployment instructions.

free-tier.rationale: Apache-2.0 local source and no-sign-in workspace path continue. This excludes any promise of free model inference. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution.

starting-price.rationale: Apache-2.0 local source and no-sign-in workspace path continue. This excludes any promise of free model inference. Scope: Local browser workspace UI, User-owned local agent execution.

byo-subscription.rationale: Official local Codex integration uses provider-native ChatGPT-plan login; current model allowances/eligibility require separate provider checks.

self-hosting.rationale: Continuing local workspace core runs on user-controlled infrastructure without vendor login. Retired hosted issue/project service and unverified remote parity are excluded.

cli.rationale: Released npx vibe-kanban command launches the local app and offers mcp and review subcommands. It is a launcher, not a task-management command set. Not tested. Scope: Local browser workspace UI.
